grain_clerk_conflict: I entered {dispatch_record}. The independent threshold tally now reads: {threshold_tally}. The roof was poor, not my measure; certify the tablet and let the household keep its reserve.
other_office_conflict: The dispatch docket states: {dispatch_record}. The independent threshold tally records: {threshold_tally}. I ask you to preserve the office's standing—and name who bears the loss.
canal_bailiff_requisition: The requisition was entered because the canal work needs hands. Our account shows {labor} labor and {barley} barley at {institution_name}; those totals do not tell you how many hands can leave their posts. I ask you to authorize the allotment, not mistake the stock ledger for a muster.
other_office_requisition: The requisition names {form_title} for {place_name}. The institution records {labor} labor and {barley} barley, but the roll does not show which hands can be spared. Certify the request or write whose stores must be reassigned.
archive_keeper: Do not make a patron's seal into evidence. Enter the source, and let the record name the responsible office.
trusted_complicit: {official_name}: We have kept one another's accounts before, {scribe_name}. A clean seal now will be remembered in your favor.
hostile_exacting: {official_name}: Do not ask me to soften a figure, {scribe_name}. Show the source and state plainly who carries the consequence.
no_witness: No witness is named in this docket; I cannot offer an account I did not see.
no_separate_demand: No separate demand was entered by this office.
record_entry_summary: The register identifies {form_title} for {place_name}, entered by {generated_by} for {generation_reason} at urgency {urgency}. This establishes the request's origin and stated reason; it does not prove the shortage.

form_demands.bailiff_requisition: I seek authorization for the labor allotment named in this requisition.
form_demands.pension_roll: I seek an assessment of the pension names and their recorded entitlements.
form_demands.grain_levy: I seek an entry for the grain assessed on this levy roll.
form_demands.travel_pass: I seek authorization of the journey and its stated terms.
form_demands.succession_claim: I seek a ruling on which succession entry may be recognized.
form_demands.consignment_receipt: I seek certification of the goods received against this consignment.

generation_reasons.local_institution_shortage: a reported shortage at the institution

office_profiles.potter: I can attest to the vessels shaped and counted at my workshop for {form_title}. I cannot certify what happened after they left my hands.
office_profiles.household_head: I speak for the stores and obligations of this household at {place_name}. I cannot turn our account into proof of the other party's entry.
office_profiles.apprentice_scribe: I entered the {form_title} brought to this desk. I can attest to the wording and date, not to events I did not witness.
office_profiles.umma_granary_clerk: My tally records what the granary received at {place_name}. Dispatch totals and quality declarations must be compared with that count.
office_profiles.canal_bailiff: I answer for the canal work rolls at {place_name}. The requisition names the work and requested allotment; the account alone cannot tell you which hands can leave their posts.
office_profiles.external_trader: My account begins at the agreed handover of the {form_title}. I cannot attest to a load after it passed from my custody.
office_profiles.carrier_foreman: I answer for my crew's count at loading and unloading at {place_name}. Any transfer without a witness remains disputed.
office_profiles.trader: I can attest to the goods and terms offered at {place_name}. I cannot certify the other party's storehouse entry.
office_profiles.player_household: I can speak to the obligations entered against my household. I cannot claim the register is wrong without a source to compare.
office_profiles.court_notary: I can certify seals, dates, and claims entered before me for {place_name}. I cannot make an absent witness appear.
office_profiles.reed_cutter: I can attest to the reeds cut and bundled for {place_name}. I cannot certify the storehouse's later count.
office_profiles.precinct_attendant: I can attest to arrivals and departures entered at the gate of {place_name}. I cannot verify goods that were never entered there.
office_profiles.textile_worker: I can attest to the bundles woven and handed over at {place_name}. I cannot verify their later grade or store count.
office_profiles.brewer: I can attest to the jars filled and delivered from the brewery at {place_name}. I cannot account for breakage after receipt.
office_profiles.archive_keeper: I can certify what the archive holds for {place_name}; an absent tablet or unmatched seal must remain an open question.
office_profiles.boat_operator: I can attest to what was loaded onto my boat and what reached the landing at {place_name}. A second craft without a witness is not part of my receipt.
office_profiles.flock_manager: I can attest to the animals counted at the pen for {place_name}. I cannot certify a rejection unless it was marked at the gate.
office_profiles.grain_clerk: I can attest to the grain entered in the storehouse at {place_name}. A quality declaration must be compared with the physical tally.
office_profiles.tax_scribe: I can attest to assessed amounts and exemptions recorded on the roll for {place_name}. I cannot certify payment without a receipt.
